sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 6:40

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 6:40:1
items.html: The ten were a simple self, and they were comprised of ten, but it was not recognisable in them: That is, while they were in the GAR of the Nekudim; for although the correction of the lines and the discernment of ten vessels were already in them, meaning that Malchut became included in each and every Sefira and ten vessels were made for the ten lights, still, since they are the discernment of a Rosh, where the screen operates in them from below upward, they are therefore still regarded as though all the lights are included in the vessel of Keter, as in the Akudim, and the matter of the ten vessels is not recognisable in them; for the discernment of coarseness is not recognisable in the discernment of from below upward, meaning before the light clothes in the vessels, as is known.

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 6:40:2
items.html: And the GAR, which were mercies, were able to receive the light of Ein Sof. As written in the adjacent item; for the discernment of coarseness, which is the secret of the quality of judgment, from the inclusion of Malchut in each and every Sefira, is not yet recognisable in the GAR, since there is no discernment of clothing in them in actuality, but only in the discernment of potential. And therefore they are mercies.

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 6:40:3
items.html: Because they are judgment, and the light that came is mercy, they were not able to receive it. As written above, that the vessels were small; for the great vessels that were in the Gufim of the three previous Partzufim of AK, which are the vessel of Keter and the vessel of Hochma, were lacking here in the Guf of the Nekudim, since they began from the Sefira of Daat downward, which is the vessel of Bina (as above, page 416, the passage beginning “And HBD”). And since the light that came to them was mercy, that is, the lights of GAR, which are called the light of mercy, and which must clothe in the refined vessels of Keter and Hochma, therefore they were not able to receive it.

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 6:40:4
items.html: Vessels for the Keter, etc., that comes and passes through a screen. He means the screen of the Yesod of Atik that was corrected in Atzilut, through which the light was sweetened, as written in its place.

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 6:40:5
items.html: That these ten would be recognisable in it. For through the discernment of the Ibur [impregnation] and the nursing, the correction of the lines and the ten vessels were corrected in the ZAT as well, and then the self clothed in the vessels.

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 6:40:6
items.html: Below Malchut of Atzilut. That is, that they expanded below the Parsa of Atzilut and went out of the boundary of the new point of restriction that was in the Nekudim. And this was their death, as written.

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 6:40:7
items.html: Hadar, because they were male and female. That is, that his Nukva was corrected as she ought to be, and therefore he endured. And this is the secret of the new name MA, which will be explained in its place.
